description: This file defines the PropertyValue data model, including its validation, search options, and related constants for handling property values in the Mattermost system.

classes.name: PropertyValue
classes.description: Represents a property value associated with a target (post or user), including validation and ID management.

classes.name: PropertyValueSearchCursor
classes.description: Used for paginating and validating search results for property values.

classes.name: PropertyValueSearchOpts
classes.description: Encapsulates search options for querying property values, including filters and pagination.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares the PropertyValue object before saving, assigning ID and timestamps if necessary.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the PropertyValue object, ensuring IDs and fields meet constraints.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the search cursor is empty.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the search cursor for correctness.
